$comment: Glob -> skills that MUST have been invoked (via the Skill tool) before a Write/Edit to a matching path.
Enforced by .claude/hooks/skills-required.js, a PreToolUse(Write|Edit) hook that exits 2 to block.
Source of truth: the skills table in the QA remediation master plan. Moving it here is the point:
the mapping stops being an agent's memory and becomes a reviewable file.
'exempt' paths are checked FIRST and never require anything - docs, QA artifacts, and this
enforcement machinery itself (otherwise the guard cannot be edited without tripping itself).
